purpose: Harden cross-batch market-state screening without changing regime-research-v1 scans or discovery-v1 strategy definitions. Future batches must show both directional stability and a minimum practical rank-association magnitude before a state hypothesis can enter a separate strategy-conditioning research test.
development_context: The pre-freeze regime-research-v1 implementation labeled cross-batch association stability from sign consistency alone. v1.1 is versioned before post-21:00 UTC capture evidence and adds a practical effect-size floor plus more independent dependence clusters. Previously inspected batches remain development context and are excluded from v1.1 eligibility.

state_screen.effect_size_note: The absolute Spearman floor is a practical screening threshold, not a calibrated significance test or profitability threshold.

redundancy_and_incremental_information.representative_selection: Use the existing PnL-independent highest independent-batch availability rule for highly redundant clusters.
redundancy_and_incremental_information.second_feature_rule: A second feature from a redundant cluster must independently pass the forward partial-Spearman effect and sign-stability screen, or have a separately pre-specified interaction rationale before later evidence is inspected.

multiple_testing: Any state hypothesis advanced into strategy-conditioning research must be frozen and entered into trial accounting before later strategy evidence is inspected. This state screen itself does not claim statistical significance.
